title: Hiring for Junior Bookkeeper | Experience with US-Based Client Required | Up to $7/hr. | Apply Now!
description:
**About Us**

We are a fast-growing U.S.-based real estate development company focused on high-quality home renovations and new construction projects in California.



We don’t just build homes — we build efficient systems, strong teams, and scalable operations.



We’re looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and reliable tea
mber who can help support bookkeeping, data entry, account reconciliation, expense tracking, and financial record management across multiple projects. 

______________________________________________________



**Why This Role is Important**

This role is a key part of our accounting and financial workflow. If records are incomplete, inaccurate, or delayed reporting suffers and decisions slow down.



Your job is to make sure that NEVER happens.

______________________________________________________



**What You’ll Be Doing**



Bookkeeping & Financial Records

-Record and categorize daily transactions accurately in QuickBooks Online (cash basis)

-Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable tracking

-Review invoices, receipts, bills, and payment records for accuracy

-Support bank, credit card, and vendor account reconciliation

-Manage multi?entity books across several QBO Entities

-Handle intercompany transactions and reconcile balances between entities



Documentation & Accounting Support

-Maintain clear, organized, and accurate financial records

-Update bookkeeping files based on new transactions and corrections

-Organize receipts, invoices, statements, and supporting documents

-Ensure consistency across records, spreadsheets, reports, and accounting systems



Coordination & Administrative Support

-Coordinate with Bookkeeper, tea
mbers, vendors, and property/project contacts as needed

-Follow-up missing invoices, receipts, W-9s, payment details, and documentation

-Track pending accounting items, payment status, and open questions

-Support basic financial reporting, expense summaries, and project cost tracking 



Accuracy & Risk Management

-Maintain accuracy, clarity, and consistency in all bookkeeping work

-Proactively flag missing information, duplicate charges, payment issues, and unusual transactions (VERY IMPORTANT)

-Help keep financial records current by completing assigned updates and reconciliations on time 



**What We’re Looking For**

Required

-Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

-At least 1-2 years of bookkeeping, accounting, or finance support experience

-Experience with data entry, expense tracking, and account reconciliation 

-Ability to review invoices, receipts, statements, and payment records accurately 

-Proficiency with spreadsheets and bookkeeping/accounting software

-Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable

-Strong English communication skills, written and verbal

-Open to working exclusively for the company 



Preferred (Big Plus)

-Experience with real estate, construction, property management, or project-based accounting

-Experience working with US-based/remote clients

-Familiarity with property tax processing 

-Experience with multi-entities and 1099 filing 

-Familiarity with accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendor payments, and W-9 documentation

-Experience tracking project costs, receipts, reimbursements, and monthly financial records 

-Basic knowledge of Quickbooks, AppFolio, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools



**Tools You May Use**

-Quickbooks or other bookkeeping/accounting software

-AppFolio or similar property management software

-Google Drive, Google Sheet, and Excel


, Deluxe, or other bill payment platforms


, WhatsApp, and Zoom for communication 



**Perks/Benefits**

–10 days paid time off (PTO)/holiday

– Maxicare health insurance (PH-based employees)

– Performance-based bonuses per property sold

– SV anniversary & birthday gifts

– 13th Month Pay with the potential to earn 2–3× based on performance and company results 

– Company sponsored team travel based on performance and company results 



**How to Apply (IMPORTANT)**

To be considered, add the following in one google drive folder and send us the link:

-Your updated resume

-2 to 3 mins. introduction video of relevant experience 

-Photo of your workstation

-Screenshot of your device specifications

-Screenshot of your internet speed test results



Due to the high volume of applications we receive, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

I'm looking for one reliable editor to own the edit end-to-end: 3–5 short videos per week (90–180 seconds each) and one long-form video per month (20–45 minutes). This is a steady, ongoing relationship, not a one-off gig. I want someone I can hand raw footage to and get back a clean cut that follows a consistent style guide, week after week.





What you'll do

Cut 3–5 short videos per week (90–180s) for TikTok / Reels / Shorts / X, vertical 9:16

Edit one long-form video per month (8–20 min) for YouTube, horizontal 16:9

title: Ecom Video Editor For Meta/TikTok Ads
description:
About Us:

We are a dynamic and rapidly growing 7-figure women's jewelry brand powered by Shopify. We are passionate about great design that speaks for itself, drawing inspiration from everyday fashion and influencers, and genuinely caring about the products we create and the relationships we build. Our marketing is performance-driven, and high-converting video creative is central to our scaling strategy.



The Role:

We're seeking a skilled and agile E-commerce Response Video Editor (full time / 40 hours per week) who understands how to create video ads that don't just look good but convert. You will work in lockstep with our Creative Strategist, taking raw footage (UGC, potentially studio shots) and briefs to produce engaging, platform-optimized video ads primarily for Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok. Your job is to execute rapidly, iterate effectively based on performance insights (provided by the strategist), and ensure the final output is engineered for maximum engagement and conversions. Forget long-form content; this is about short, punchy, direct-response video.



Key Responsibilities:



• Edit High-Performing Video Ads: Transform raw footage and strategist briefs into compelling video ads optimized for Meta and TikTok feeds/stories/reels.



• Rapid Iteration: Quickly execute multiple variations of winning ad concepts provided by the Creative Strategist (testing different hooks, visuals, text overlays, CTAs, music). Understand that iteration based on data is key.



• Platform Optimization: Expertly edit for platform best practices – strong hooks within the first 3 seconds, fast pacing, engaging captions/text overlays, appropriate aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 4:5), safe zones, and effective sound design.



• Integrate Copy & CTAs: Seamlessly weave in primary text concepts, headlines, and clear calls-to-action as guided by the strategist.



• Collaborate Closely: Maintain clear, fast communication (Slack, etc.) with the Creative Strategist to receive feedback, discuss edits, and ensure alignment with performance goals.



• Asset Management: Organize and manage video files and project assets efficiently.



• Meet Deadlines: Deliver high-quality edits reliably and on schedule in a fast-paced environment.



Who We're Looking For:



• Proven Social Ad Editing Experience: Minimum 2+ experience specifically editing short-form video advertisements for performance marketing campaigns on Meta & TikTok. A portfolio showcasing direct-response style video ads is required.



• Technical Proficiency: Highly skilled in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut is a major plus). Proficiency in basic motion graphics (e.g., After Effects for text overlays) is desirable.



• Platform Native: Deep understanding of what works visually on TikTok and Meta feeds/stories/reels – you know the trends, the hooks, the pacing, the sounds that grab attention immediately.



• Performance-Oriented Mindset: You understand the goal is conversion, not just aesthetics. You are receptive to feedback driven by ad metrics and can adapt edits accordingly. (Links to Strategist's "Data Mastery," "Creativity That Converts").



• Speed and Agility: Ability to work quickly, execute variations efficiently, and adapt to changing requirements without sacrificing quality. (Links to Strategist's "Adaptability & Agility").



• Collaborative Spirit: Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively and receive direction from a Creative Strategist. (Links to Strategist's "Collaboration is Key," "Clear Communication").



• Strong Work Ethic & Accountability: Reliable, proactive, meets deadlines, and takes ownership of edit quality – no babysitting needed. (Links to Strategist's "Work Ethic").



• Detail-Oriented: Ensures brand consistency, correct aspect ratios, and error-free text/graphics. Nothing sloppy makes the cut.



• Basic understanding of direct response marketing principles.



• Experience editing UGC content.



Compensation:

$1,000 base monthly salary, plus performance-based bonus/incentives tied to creative contribution.



How to Apply:



In your proposal, please include:



1. Provide your Resume/CV and link to your portfolio showcasing performance-driven social video ads for Meta/TikTok.

2. Briefly describe your process for editing a typical 15-45 sec. video ad.

3. How do you handle feedback and rapid iteration requests from creative strategists?

Aviora is building one of the fastest-growing supplement brands in the DTC space — and paid social is the engine behind it. We're now looking for an elite Meta media buyer to join our in-house team and own the performance of our paid campaigns from day one.

We don't guess. We test, we read data, and we scale what works. If you're the kind of operator who treats every dollar of ad spend as a decision — and can back every decision with numbers — we want to talk.



YOUR MISSION

Your mission is to profitably scale Aviora's customer acquisition through Meta paid social. You will own the full ad account — from campaign architecture and creative testing to budget management and performance reporting — ensuring we are consistently acquiring customers at or below target CAC while scaling spend efficiently.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Own and manage Aviora's Meta ad account end-to-end across
 and Instagram

Build, launch, and optimize campaigns across prospecting and retargeting funnels

Develop and execute structured creative testing frameworks to identify winning angles, hooks, and formats at pace

Work closely with the creative team to brief, review, and iterate on static and video ad assets based on performance data

Monitor daily performance metrics and make proactive adjustments to bids, budgets, audiences, and creatives

Operate with a high degree of autonomy — you manage your account, flag issues early, and don't wait to be told what to fix

Maintain clear, proactive communication with founders and the executive team on performance, spend, and scaling decisions

Stay ahead of platform changes, algorithm shifts, and new Meta ad features — and apply them before competitors do





OUR TECH STACK



Ad Platform: Meta Ads Manager

Analytics: Triple Whale, Google Analytics, or equivalent attribution tools

Creative Management: Notion

Communication & Project Management: Slack & 





KPIs YOU WILL OWN



CAC: Customer acquisition cost at or below target threshold

ROAS: Campaign and account-level return on ad spend targets met consistently

Creative Velocity: New creative tests launched weekly — you move fast and keep the testing pipeline full

Spend Efficiency: Budget allocated and scaled in line with performance, no wasted spend sitting in underperforming ad sets





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Proven experience running and scaling Meta ad accounts for DTC or eCommerce brands — supplement or health/wellness experience is a strong plus

Demonstrated ability to scale budgets profitably — we want to see numbers, not just titles

Deep understanding of Meta campaign structure, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing methodology

Strong analytical instinct — you read data daily and make decisions from it, not gut feel

Experience briefing and collaborating with creative teams to produce performance-driven ad assets

An autonomous operator who owns outcomes, communicates proactively, and doesn't need hand-holding

Up to date on iOS privacy changes, Meta's evolving algorithm, and how to navigate attribution in a post-cookie environment





WHY JOIN AVIORA



Performance-Based Rewards: Bonus structure tied directly to account performance — when the numbers hit, you share in the upside

High Impact: You will have direct influence over the growth trajectory of a fast-scaling brand with a proven product

Work with the Best: Join a team of A-players across creative, video, and strategy who are all rowing in the same direction

High Autonomy: You own the account. We give you the budget, the creative team, and the trust — then we get out of your way

Growth Trajectory: For high performers, there are clear opportunities to step into a Head of Paid or Growth Lead role as the brand scales

Results-Driven Flexibility: We measure output, not hours. Be reachable during core hours (9AM–8PM ET), attend the Monday 12PM ET weekly call, and deliver results

Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You prefer to set campaigns and check in weekly. This account needs daily attention, fast iteration, and sharp decision-making. If you're a passive manager, this isn't the right fit.

You struggle when platform rules change overnight. Meta's ad ecosystem shifts constantly — policy updates, algorithm changes, creative fatigue — and you need to adapt without losing 
ntum.

You see media buying as purely a numbers game with no creative involvement. At Aviora, the media buyer and creative team work closely together. You'll need to have strong opinions on what makes an ad perform, not just what makes it spend.

You want a stable, predictable workflow. We are scaling aggressively. Budgets move, priorities shift, and new opportunities need to be acted on fast. If that's stressful rather than energising, this isn't the right environment.



HOW TO APPLY

If you're an elite Meta media buyer who wants to own a high-growth ad account, work directly with founders, and be rewarded when the performance is there — we want to hear from you.

Answer all application questions thoroughly and show us specifically how your past results map to what this role demands. Numbers preferred over descriptions.

Include the code word 'DetailsMatter' somewhere in your application. We will only review candidates who follow this instruction. It's the first test.

This is a fully remote opportunity.?????

title: Expert Facebook Ad Video Editor — AI Voiceover (ElevenLabs) Experienced Only
description:
We’re looking for a highly skilled video ad editor to produce high-converting
/Meta ads, with Instagram and TikTok experience as a strong plus. This is not an entry-level role — if you don’t have proven experience editing paid social ads with portfolio proof, please do not apply.



Role Overview

You will take raw footage, stock clips, and AI-generated assets and turn them into scroll-stopping
 ads with sharp pacing, clean cuts, and strong hooks within the first 3 seconds. You’ll generate and sync AI voiceovers using ElevenLabs, matching tone, emotion, and rhythm to the visuals. Expect ongoing work producing multiple ad variations, cutdowns, and retargeting versions every week.



What You’ll Do

Edit short-form performance ads specifically for Meta 
 & Instagram), with TikTok as a plus.

Turn raw footage, stock/b-roll, and AI assets into polished, high-converting ad creatives.

Generate and sync AI voiceovers in ElevenLabs, choosing the right voice, emotion, and pacing for each script.

Add captions/subtitles, hooks, transitions, sound effects, and optimized pacing for paid social.

Produce multiple variations, cutdowns, and retargeting versions based on performance and feedback.

Follow creative briefs and direction closely while maintaining consistent quality and speed.



Required Skills & Experience

This is a performance-editing role, not a generic video editor position.

You must:

Have proven experience editing e-commerce ads specifically for Meta/Facebook (not just organic or long-form content).

Be confident with clipping, pacing, and timing for paid social ads — especially strong hooks within the first 3 seconds and high retention through the first 30 seconds.

Have hands-on experience with ElevenLabs for AI voiceover generation (voice selection, emotion tuning, and clean audio output).

Be highly proficient in CapCut Pro, Premiere Pro, or After Effects.

Be comfortable with captions/subtitles, sound design, b-roll layering, and basic motion graphics.

Have a strong understanding of what actually performs inside Meta Ads Manager (creatives, hooks, formats that drive results).

Have experience with short-form ad formats: UGC-style ads, voiceover ads, and product/demo ads.

Be able to meet daily deadlines, work independently, and communicate clearly in English.

Reliable internet, a capable editing setup, and the ability to handle ongoing work are non-negotiable.



Application Requirements (Strict)

To be considered, your proposal must include all of the following:

Direct links to previous
/Meta ads you have personally edited (not team projects, not generic reels).

Names of past clients or brands you’ve worked with, and case studies or results if available.

A short note on your editing workflow:

Software you use

How you approach hooks, pacing, and retention

How you integrate ElevenLabs voiceovers into your edits

Applications without work samples or without clear
/Meta ad experience will be rejected immediately. Do not apply if you are not specialized in paid social ad editing.



Trial Period (Paid)

Before moving to full-time, there will be a paid 2-week trial to evaluate:

Skill level and creative quality

Speed and consistency

Ability to follow directions and implement feedback

Trial terms:

Pay during trial: 8 USD per completed video/ad

Training, examples, and feedback will be provided

Only candidates who pass the trial will be considered for the full-time role



Full-Time Role Details (After Trial)

Weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

Scripts are sent every weekday

Videos must be completed and delivered before the following day

Task-based work (no fixed hours, but daily deliverables are required)

Payment: 212 USD per week, paid every Sunday

Performance bonus: 150 USD for any “winning ad” that performs well in paid campaigns

This is a long-term, stable role for the right editor.



Responsibilities

Edit short-form voiceover ads for Meta 
 & Instagram), with TikTok as a plus.

Sync visuals tightly to ElevenLabs-generated voiceovers (access will be provided).

Use provided b-roll, product assets, and custom b-roll where needed.

Add attention-grabbing hooks, captions, transitions, and sound design optimized for paid social.

Follow creative briefs, brand guidelines, and iterative feedback closely.

Maintain consistent quality while hitting fast turnarounds.



Who This Role Is For

This role is for someone who:

Edits for performance and conversions first, not just aesthetics.

Understands hooks, pacing, and retention in a paid social context.

Wants a stable, long-term position with predictable weekly work.

Is motivated by performance-based bonuses and “winning ads.”

Can grow with the brand and contribute ideas to improve creatives over time

title: Senior Credit Dispute Manager (DisputeFox & GHL Expert)
description:
**Location:** Remote (Philippines)

**Shift:** 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST (Monday – Friday)





We are a fast-growing Real Estate and Loan Pre-approval firm looking for a **Growth-Minded Dispute Expert** to lead our credit restoration wing. This is not a role for a "template sender." We need a strategist who understands the "why" behind the dispute, knows how to leverage the law, and can manage high-level workflows in **DisputeFox** and **GoHighLevel**.



**IMPORTANT:** We are looking for a dedicated tea
mber. If you currently run your own credit repair business or manage multiple outside clients, please do not apply.



Key Responsibilities:



* **Advanced Dispute Strategy:** Execute "Updated Methods" (Factual, Metro2, or Administrative) beyond basic 609 letters.

* **Legal Triage:** Identify clear violations (re-insertions without notice, failure to investigate) and prepare files for referral to our **FCRA Attorney** partners.

* **Financial Problem Solving:** Resolve complex banking "blockages" including **ChexSystems** and **EWS** (Early Warning Services) to restore client banking privileges.

* **Student Loan Management:** Navigate the 2026 "RAP" (Repayment Assistance Plan) and Tiered Standard rules. Direct clients through consolidations and IDR applications to improve Debt-to-Income (DTI) ratios.

* **Strategic Communication:** Write high-impact **Goodwill Letters** when traditional disputes aren't the best path.

* **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Work daily with our Loan and Real Estate teams. You will use **GoHighLevel** to update pipelines, trigger automations, and communicate with clients.



Required Experience & Skills



* **Software Mastery:** 2+ years of hands-on experience in **DisputeFox** AND **GoHighLevel** (GHL).

* **Management Background:** Experience managing a dispute team or a high volume of files during a scaling phase.

* **English Proficiency:** Mastery of the English language is a must. You must be able to explain complex credit concepts to American clients with confidence and empathy.

* **Technical Knowledge:** * Deep understanding of the **Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)**.

    * Knowledge of **Student Loan Consolidation** and the latest 2026 IDR/RAP guidelines.

    * Proven track record of removing ChexSystems/EWS records.

* **Growth Mindset:** You thrive in a fast-paced environment and look for ways to optimize workflows as we scale.



### **Technical Requirements**

* Reliable high-speed internet (Backup connection required).

* Noise-canceling headset and a professional, quiet home office setup.

* Must be available during **10am - 6pm EST** (no exceptions).



---



How to Apply



1. Submit your updated Resume.

2. Provide a brief summary of your experience managing a team within **DisputeFox**.

3. **The "Check":** Include a 1-minute voice recording or video explaining when you would choose a **Goodwill Letter** over a standard dispute.

title: SEO Specialist (Local SEO + AI Search / GEO & AEO) — US Senior Care
description:
Golden Years Home Care is a family-owned senior in-home care company in California, celebrating our 30th year of helping families care for their aging loved ones. We provide premium, white-glove in-home care — including Alzheimer's, dementia, and 24-hour care — across multiple cities: Sacramento, Roseville, Elk Grove, Lincoln, and San Diego.

We are hiring a long-term SEO Specialist to own how Golden Years shows up online — in traditional Google search, local maps, AND in modern AI answers from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity. This is a stable, long-term role for someone who wants to grow with a compassionate and thriving company.

What You'll Do

1. Local SEO (Our #1 Priority)

Optimize Google Business Profiles (GBP) for all our locations (categories, services, posts, photos, Q&A).

Rank us in the local map pack and "near me" searches for terms like in-home care, dementia care, and senior caregiver in each city we serve.

Build and clean up local citations and directory listings; keep NAP (Name, Address, Phone) strictly consistent.

Help grow and manage our online reviews strategy.

2. Technical & On-Page SEO

Run site audits and fix indexing, site speed, mobile responsiveness, and Core Web Vitals issues (our site is on WordPress / Divi).

Implement advanced structured data / schema markup (LocalBusiness, FAQ, Service, Review).

Optimize titles, meta descriptions, headers, and internal linking structures.

Conduct keyword research, topic clustering, and search-intent mapping.

3. AI Search Visibility (GEO, AEO & LLMO)

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): Optimize our content to get surfaced and cited inside AI search results.

AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): Structure content as clear, answer-first responses to win featured snippets, voice search, and AI direct answers.

LLMO: Improve how AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) reference and recommend Golden Years.

Build semantically rich, entity-based content that establishes our authority in senior and dementia care.

Track where and how we appear across AI search platforms.

4. Content Strategy & Reporting

Collaborate with our marketing team on SEO content (service pages, location pages, blogs).

Monitor rankings, organic traffic, local visibility, and conversions.

Provide clear monthly reports highlighting what's working and outlining the next actionable steps.

Skills & Requirements

Experience: 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience with proven ranking/traffic results.

Local SEO Expertise: Strong multi-location experience (Google Business Profile, map pack, citations).

Modern SEO Mindset: Knowledge of GEO/AEO and a real, active interest in AI search optimization.

Tools: Proficient with Google Search Console, Google Analytics (GA4), and SEMrush or Ahrefs.

Technical: Experience with Screaming Frog (or similar audit tools), WordPress (Divi is a plus), and basic HTML.

Communication: Excellent written English — you will be writing and optimizing content for a premium US audience.

Setup: Reliable computer + high-speed, stable internet connection.

Mindset: Self-directed, highly organized, and dependable for long-term work.

Nice to Have:

Experience working with US clients, healthcare, senior care, or local-services businesses.

Deep familiarity with advanced schema markup and AI citation tracking.

Experience with GoHighLevel.

Graphic design or basic Canva skills.

Why Join Us?

Stability: Long-term, stable, full-time role with a respected 30-year-old company.

Impact: Work on meaningful marketing — every lead you bring in helps a family get the care they need.

Culture: Friendly team and direct communication with the marketing manager.

Growth: Room to grow as we continue to expand our footprint across California.

How to Apply

?? Important: To show us you actually read this post and pay attention to details (and aren't sending a generic, copy-paste application), please follow these steps exactly:

Start your application message with the word "SUNRISE" at the very top. Applications without this word will be automatically filtered out.

Briefly tell us about one local SEO or AI-search win you are proud of — what you did, and what the concrete result was.

Attach your resume and any examples/screenshots of rankings or organic traffic growth you have driven.

(Optional but highly appreciated) Include a link to a short 1-minute video introducing yourself.

We review every application that follows these steps. We are excited to meet you!

Golden Years Home Care is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Billing Specialist
description:
It has to make sense. That is the standard at Divorce With A Plan. Not "close enough." Not "that is just how billing works." It has to make sense to the client, or we have not done our job.



Clients are high-net-worth professionals going through divorce across the state of Maryland. They are intelligent, capable people navigating a financial experience they were never trained for. They do not know what an evergreen retainer is. They do not know what a trust replenishment request means or why it matters. And if no one explains it in a way that makes sense to them, they lose confidence in the process, and they lose sight of the plan they are working toward.



That is the problem this role solves.



The Billing Specialist at Divorce With A Plan is the person who makes the financial side of a divorce case make sense to the client. You walk beside them from the day they retain the firm through the day the case closes, connecting every payment to the outcome they are working toward. You are part of their walk. You are the one who helps them see that the $5,000 retainer replenishment is not just a number. It is the next step toward the custody arrangement they need, the property division that protects their future, the agreement that lets them move forward.



The time you spend with clients explaining their billing, answering their questions, and making sure their plan still makes sense to them is not an extra. It is not a favor. It is part of the service. There is no additional cost to the client for the time you invest in making sure they understand. That is how this firm works, and it is one of the reasons clients trust us.



How we do it: the right way.



This firm runs on structure. There is a defined process for everything, because when the process is clear, the client gets a consistent experience no matter which attorney is on their case or which week of the month it is. You will have a daily call block schedule so clients are never waiting days for a return call. You will have a billing script built on the Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct so clients hear accurate, compliant information every time. You will have an escalation protocol with documented timestamps, so no client concern sits unaddressed. You will have a weekly deliverable that captures how clients are feeling, what they need, and what feedback they are giving us, so the firm can respond to what clients are actually experiencing, not what we assume they are experiencing.



If you are someone who finds relief in knowing exactly what the standard is, exactly what a good day looks like, and exactly what is expected, keep reading.



What you produce: a contribution that protects the client and the firm.



The Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct require that clients be kept informed about the status of their matter (Rule 1.4), that fees are reasonable and clearly communicated (Rule 1.5), and that client funds held in trust are safeguarded with precision (Rule 1.15). Those rules exist to protect the client. Everything this role does is built around upholding them.



Every call you make either keeps a client informed or it does not. Every replenishment conversation either connects the payment to the client's goals and gives them the information they are entitled to, or it leaves them making financial decisions without the full picture. Every trust balance you monitor either gets flagged the same day it drops below threshold, protecting the client's funds and the firm's fiduciary obligation, or it becomes the kind of gap that puts both at risk.



You are not here to process invoices. You are here to contribute to something that matters: a client's ability to get through the hardest financial experience of their life with clarity, dignity, and a plan that makes sense to them, while ensuring the fir
ets the professional standards that make all of that possible. Here is who thrives in this role.



You genuinely like people. Not in theory. In practice. You are energized by 20+ phone conversations a day because you actually want to know how someone is doing, and they can tell the difference. You remember that a client's daughter just started high school, that another client lost their job two months ago, that someone told you in March they were scared about the mediation in May, and when you call in May, you ask about it before you ask about the balance.







You are organized because you cannot function without a system. You manage 100 to 150 active client relationships, and nothing falls through because you built something (a spreadsheet, a calendar, a color-coded tracker, a handwritten list) that keeps you moving. You do not wait for someone to tell you what needs attention. You see the attorney's calendar, you see the hearing in two weeks, and you pick up the phone, because the client deserves to know what is coming before it arrives.



You have the emotional range to sit with a client who is crying about their financial situation on Tuesday and have a firm, direct conversation about a past-due balance on Wednesday, and both conversations are authentic because both come from the same place: you care about this person's outcome, and you are going to tell them the truth.



You have been described as "the person who can get anyone to pay," and you know the reason is not pressure. It is trust. People pay you because you took the time to help them understand what they were paying for and why it mattered to their case.



Here is who this role is not for.

1. If you want to process invoices in a back office and never talk to a client, this role will make you miserable.

2. If you avoid difficult conversations about money, you will not survive the first month. These clients are going through a divorce. Money is emotional. You need to be able to hold that space and still move the conversation forward, because the client needs someone who will stay in it with them.

3. If you need someone to tell you what to do every hour, this is not the right structure for you. You will have clear expectations, daily blocks, and weekly deliverables. Within that framework, you think, prioritize, and act. Problems get fixed or flagged, because a problem that sits is a client who waits.



If you read from a script without understanding why each line exists, you will fail here. Every call requires context. You know what is happening in the client's case before you dial, and you lead with that, because a client who feels known is a client who stays engaged in their own plan.



If the phrase "it has to make sense" does not resonate with you at a gut level, if you are comfortable with "good enough" or "that is just how we do it," you will not be happy working here.



Responsibilities

1. Make the Financial Side of the Case Make Sense from Day One

2. Within five business days of retention, deliver a billing tutorial covering retainer structure, evergreen replenishment, invoice format, and what to expect at each stage, so the client starts their case understanding how the financial side works before they receive their first invoice.

3. Conduct a live introductory call to walk through the material, answer questions, and establish the relationship. This call gives the client a person they can reach when billing feels confusing, and it gives you the context to serve them well for the life of their case.

4. Provide specific dollar ranges for upcoming cost events (hearings: $5,000-$10,000, mediations, trials: $15,000-$30,000) so the client can plan ahead instead of reacting to surprises.

5. Introduce yourself as a non-billable point of contact. The time you spend making sure their plan still makes sense to them is part of the service, not an add-on. Clients who know they can call you without a meter running are clients who stay informed and engaged.

6. Keep Trust Accounts Funded by Keeping Clients Informed

7. Monitor trust balances daily across
active matters so no client's case is disrupted by a funding gap they did not see coming.

8. Call every client before sending a replenishment request. No
 goes out without a phone call attempt. The call comes first because the client deserves a conversation, not a demand.

9. When requesting additional retainers for upcoming events, reference the specific event by name and the date you first discussed it. This tells the client you are paying attention to their case, not just their balance.

10. Flag any matter below the trust threshold the same day. Not at the next billing cycle. The same day. A delay means the client's case could stall without warning.

11. Process Invoices the Right Way

12. Prepare, review, and distribute client invoices on a biweekly cycle, so clients receive accurate, consistent billing they can follow.

13. Review every time entry on every invoice for accuracy, specificity, and consistency. Flag entries that are vague, duplicative, or do not reflect the actual work performed, because a confusing invoice erodes the client's trust in the firm.

15. Contact timekeepers directly to resolve questionable entries before pre-bills go to attorneys. The client should never have to question whether an entry is real.

17. Distribute finalized invoices on the scheduled date with payment links included so clients always know what they owe and how to pay without chasing anyone down.

18. Collect by Connecting Payment to Progress

19. Maintain accounts receivable below 2% of total billings.

20. Execute 12-15 outbound calls per day during the morning AR block, with every call documented in Clio so the client's history is always current if another tea
mber needs to step in.

21. Lead every collections conversation with a case update: what was accomplished, what is upcoming, and how the work connects to the client's goal. The client hears the value before they hear the number.

22. When a client says they cannot pay, walk through every option: credit cards, personal loans, family support, employer assistance, and legal fee financing. You do not accept "I cannot" without helping them look at every door first, because a client who feels they have no options may abandon a case they still need.

23. Send payment links the same day after any commitment so the client can act while the conversation is fresh.

24. Listen, Learn, and Report What Clients Need

Pay attention to what clients tell you on every call. Their questions, their frustrations, their confusion, and their feedback are data the firm needs to hear so we can serve them better.

25. Produce a weekly deliverable every Friday, capturing client feedback, recurring questions, unresolved needs, and what you are hearing about the client experience. This is how the firm stays connected to what clients actually need instead of guessing.

26. When a billing concern arises, log it with a documented timestamp and route it to the responsible attorney via
 so the client gets a response, not silence.

27. Escalate any concern involving bar grievance, fraud, or legal action language to firm leadership the same day, because those situations require immediate attention to protect the client and the firm.

28. Stay Ahead of the Attorneys

Check attorney calendars for upcoming hearings, mediations, and trials. Initiate additional retainer requests before anyone asks, so the client has time to prepare instead of scrambling.

29. Confirm all credits, write-offs, and billing holds in writing before any related bill is finalized. If a credit is pending and you are not certain it has been applied, hold the bill. A client should never receive an invoice that does not reflect what the firm already knows.

30. Document every retainer reduction, billing pause, or special instruction in Clio at the matter level the same day so the next person who touches the file has the full picture and the client never has to repeat themselves.



Qualifications

Required:

 • 2+ years in billing, collections, or accounts receivable in a professional services environment. Law firm experience strongly preferred.

 • High comfort with outbound phone calls and client-facing conversations. This role requires 20+ calls per day. If phones drain you, this is not the right fit.

 • Proficiency with practice management software (Clio Manage preferred, or ability to learn within 30 days).

 • Ability to read and interpret legal invoices, time entries, trust account statements, and engagement agreements.

 • Strong written communication for documented escalations, client correspondence, and weekly deliverables.

 • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Calendar, Drive).

 • Demonstrated ability to manage 100+ active relationships simultaneously without dropping threads.



Preferred

 • Experience in a family law firm or litigation practice.

 • Familiarity with the Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct as they relate to billing. Training provided, but baseline awareness accelerates onboarding.

 • Experience with evergreen retainer models and trust accounting.

 • Prior use of LawPay, Dialpad, or Clio Grow.

 • Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.



About Divorce with a Plan

Benefits / Why Work Here

 • Fully remote. We serve clients across the entire state of Maryland. You work from wherever you work best.

 • A firm that builds systems so clients get a consistent experience. You will have scripts, checklists, escalation protocols, a daily structure, and technology supporting you from day one.

 • Direct impact you can measure. Your collections rate, your AR percentage, the client feedback you surface: you will see exactly how your work makes a difference for real people going through real situations.

 • Training on the Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct as they apply to billing. This gives you compliance knowledge that transfers to any law firm career and ensures every client interaction meets the standard.



How to Apply

 • Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your legal billing experience, familiarity with trust accounting, and any experience with Clio or similar platforms. Bilingual candidates are encouraged to note their language proficiency.

 • As part of the application process, please also complete the initial interview using the link below:

title: ClickUp Consultant
description:
ClickUp Expert – Workflow & Best Practices Consultant



Type: Project-Based Gig | Independent Contractor

Project Length: 3 weeks (fixed timeline)

Pay Structure: Fixed project price, paid out in milestones upon completion of agreed deliverables

Location: Remote | (U.S. Eastern Time availability preferred for live working sessions)

Engagement: Defined-scope consulting project with potential for ongoing retainer support after completion



About 


 is a leading provider of business book summaries, delivering professional, high-quality insights in text and audio formats. We help professionals stay current and competitive by distilling the best ideas from today’s bestselling business books. 
 is a subsidiary of Soundview, Inc.



Position Summary


 is seeking a seasoned ClickUp Expert to help us design, implement, and optimize ClickUp as the central operating system for our content production, marketing, and editorial workflows. This is a focused, 3-week project-based engagement with a fixed price paid out in milestones. The goal: set up scalable best practices, custom workflows, automations, dashboards, and team adoption frameworks that our team can confidently run on once your engagement concludes.

You’ll work directly with our leadership and operations team to audit our current processes, recommend a clean architecture (Workspaces, Spaces, Folders, Lists, and Statuses), and build out the structures, templates, automations, and reporting we need to manage book summary production, freelancer coordination, marketing campaigns, and cross-team projects.

We value both the skills and dedication of our team. We’re looking for someone proactive, inquisitive, and confident enough to speak up—even when it’s tough. To support a strong outcome, we will provide context, access, and decision-makers on demand so you can move quickly.

You’ll have access to stakeholders, but success here requires independence, accountability, and initiative. We expect you to take ownership of the build, do your own research when needed, and adopt a “whatever it takes” attitude to deliver a system our team will actually use.



What we expect:

- Share feedback, ideas, and insights to improve our operations

- Recommend tools, integrations, or training to boost team impact

- Contribute creative thinking on workflow design and automation

- Stay focused on practical, adoption-ready results that benefit the team

If that sounds like you—and you have the skills we need—we’d love to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

Workspace Audit & Architecture

• Audit our existing ClickUp setup (or current tools/processes) and identify gaps, redundancies, and opportunities.

• Design a scalable hierarchy of Workspaces, Spaces, Folders, and Lists that maps to how our teams actually work.

• Define standardized statuses, priorities, tags, and naming conventions across the workspace.



Workflow & Template Build-Out

• Build reusable task templates and list templates for recurring workflows (book summary production, marketing campaigns, editorial calendar, freelancer assignments, etc.).

• Configure custom fields, custom task types, dependencies, and relationships to reflect real-world handoffs.

• Set up forms for intake requests (e.g., new book titles, content requests, freelancer onboarding).



Automations & Integrations

• Build automations to eliminate manual hand-offs (status changes, assignments, due-date logic, recurring tasks, notifications).

• Configure integrations with our existing stack (Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Outlook, and other tools as relevant).

• Recommend and configure AI features within ClickUp where they provide clear value.



Dashboards & Reporting

• Build role-based dashboards for leadership, project managers, and individual contributors.

• Configure views (List, Board, Calendar, Gantt, Timeline, Workload) tuned to each team’s needs.

• Set up reporting on throughput, capacity, deadlines, and bottlenecks.



Documentation, Training & Handoff

• Document the workspace structure, conventions, and “how we work in ClickUp” so the team has a clear reference.

• Lead live training sessions (recorded) for tea
mbers and managers.

• Provide a clean handoff package so our team can confidently operate the system independently.



Qualifications

• 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring and administering ClickUp at the Workspace level (not just using it as an end user).

• Demonstrated track record of building ClickUp from scratch or overhauling existing setups for small-to-mid-sized teams.

• Deep knowledge of ClickUp features: Spaces, custom fields, custom task types, automations, dashboards, forms, docs, goals, and views.

• Experience designing workflows for content production, editorial, marketing, or media operations is strongly preferred.

• Strong process-design mindset—able to translate messy real-world processes into clean, scalable structures.

• Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to lead training and write clear documentation.

• Self-directed, responsive, and comfortable working with U.S.-based stakeholders.

• ClickUp Admin Certificate is a plus.

• Must have your own computer and a reliable internet connection.



Contract Terms

• Independent contractor engagement—defined-scope, project-based.

• Fixed project price agreed upon before kickoff, paid out in milestones tied to completion of agreed deliverables.

• 3-week project timeline with clear milestones and deliverables defined in a Statement of Work.

• Must provide your own computer and maintain appropriate tools for remote work.

• 
 will provide ClickUp admin access and any necessary credentials for integrated systems.

• Potential for ongoing retainer support after the initial build is complete.



Interview Process



If you would like to work with us on this project, respond directly to this job description with:

- A brief overview of your ClickUp consulting experience, including 1–2 examples of past workspace builds (anonymized if needed).

- Your proposed fixed price for a 3-week engagement of this scope, along with a suggested milestone breakdown.

- Links to any ClickUp certifications, portfolio pieces, references, or LinkedIn profile.

If we feel you may be a good fit, we will follow up with:

- A short discovery call (Zoom or Microsoft Teams) to walk through your experience and our needs.

- A scoping conversation to finalize deliverables, milestones, and pricing before signing a Statement of Work.

title: WixWebsite Cleanup and Fine Tune
description:
For the website:







Correct the following things:

1. Homepage structure

2. Flow Refinement

3. Call to Action (B.O.T. integration/Interactive A.I. B.O.T. implementation)[I have an avatar in mind for use here.

4. Call to action placements

5. Layout Spacing

6. Visual Hierarchy

7. Cleanup*[this refers to section A below]

8. Conversion Guidance (Call to action related)

9. Navigation Simplification

10. UX alignment



In addition to these things as well:

1. Performance & Technical Health and Mobile Friendliness

2. Content Quality & Credibility

3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) [considering the next task after this is the implementation 

of a TikTok Shop instead of a Shopify Store connection.      .

4. Analytics & Visitor Behavior (Can you determine these things without access to the site admin?)





Section A:

**Audit Summary**



I inspected [
](
), its shop pages, 

sitemap/robots files, rendered homepage structure, mobile layout behavior, and the visible A.I. 

chat widget. Short version: the brand/world is distinctive, but the site is currently carrying too 

much navigation, too many competing paths, weak mobile containment, uneven SEO structure, and 

unclear conversion priority. Those issues should be cleaned up before TikTok Shop integration, 

because TikTok traffic will be mostly mobile, fast-moving, and conversion-sensitive. [Creation of the TikTok store will be another gig/job]



**Highest Priority Findings**



1. **Mobile friendliness needs urgent refinement**

The homepage does not fit cleanly into a phone-width viewport. In a 390px mobile test, 

desktop-style navigation and CTA elements extended far off-screen, creating horizontal overflow. 

This is the biggest practical issue because TikTok Shop traffic will likely arrive from 

mobile/in-app browsing.



2. **Navigation is too deep**

The homepage exposed about **70 links/ 65 unique URLs**, including many character, universe, 

community, group, member, and forum. This needs to not be deleted but repurposed to not be this "deep", , but cleaner and then leading to the depth in a more smooth fashion.



shop, and dynamic pages. This weakens visitor decision-making. Recommended top-level nav: 

·Home'·,Universe','Books','Shop',

·Characters·, ·Community'·,Contact'. Everything else should sit under structured hub pages.



3. **Homepage hierarchy is confused**

The page has multiple'H1' elements: "ALL About The Author," "Enter The UnderShadow Universe," and 

duplicate "Enter The UnderShadow Agency Mall." The actual first-screen brand/title is marked as' 

H2', not 'H1•. This hurts accessibility, SEO clarity, and conversion flow. The homepage should have 

one primary'H1', likely "The UnderShadow Agency," with secondary sections beneath it.



4. **CTA flow is visually present but strategically unclear**

There are CTAs for Shop, About, Mall, subscription, contact, and A.I. chat, but the page does not 

make one primary next action obvious. For TikTok Shop readiness, the site should prioritize:

'Watch/Discover-> Shop featured item-> Join briefing list-> Ask C.O.S.M.O.S./B.O.T.' Right now 

those actions compete rather than guide.



5. **B.O.T./A.I. chat is present, but response reliability needs review**

The "Chat with Al" widget opened successfully and displayed a welcome response. I tested a simple 

query: "Where can I buy books or merch?" The message appeared in the chat, but I did not observe a 

follow-up A.I. answer during the test window. That should be retested inside the site/admin tooling 

because the front-end trigger works, but the response flow may need tuning.

6. **Performance risk is high**

The rendered homepage showed about **155 observed assets**, including roughly **100 scripts**, **21 

images**, **7 fonts**, **2 stylesheets**, and **1 video asset**. Wix handles some optimization 

automatically, including AVIF image delivery, but this is still heavy. Adding TikTok pixels, 

product embeds, automation scripts, or richer bot behavior without cleanup may worsen mobile load 

and responsiveness.



7. **Accessibility and image metadata need cleanup**

On the homepage, I found **26 images** with **10 missing alt attributes**. On the APEX merch page, 

**18 images** with **9 missing alt attributes**. This affects accessibility, SEO, and product 

discoverability.



8. **Shop/CRO readiness is incomplete**

The [Book Shop](
) page has a weak meta description: "Book Shop." 

The [APEX merch page] (
) has no visible heading structure 

detected and no meta description. Product listings are present, but the commerce path'i).eeds 

stronger product storytelling, trust cues, shipping/return clarity, reviews/social proof, and 

direct "Buy now" behavior.



9. **Product sitemap appears stale**

The [store product sitemap](
) lists 

products last modified in **2021**, while the page sitemap shows many pages updated around **May 

19, 2026**. Before TikTok Shop, product metadata should be refreshed: titles, descriptions, images, 

availability, pricing, canonical URLs, and structured product data where possible.



10. **SEO indexability is mostly open, but sitemap structure is noisy**

The [robots.txt](
) allows crawling and points to sitemaps. 

The [main sitemap](
. 
/sitemap.xml) includes many multilingual and 

dynamic sitemap entries. That is not inherently bad, but it increases the need for clean carionical 

strategy, correct page titles, and no thin/duplicate dynamic pages.



**Additional Categories To Add**



- **Accessibility/WCAG:** heading order, alt text, keyboard navigation, contrast, form labels, chat 

accessibility.

- **SEO governance:** page titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, duplicate "copy-of' URLs, 

product schema.

- **Commerce trust:** shipping, returns, delivery time, payment methods, product size/fit info, 

reviews.

- **TikTok Shop readiness:** mobile product landing pages, pixel/events, UTM tracking, product feed 

quality, creator/social proof.

- **Content architecture:** separate "world-building" from "buy/subscribe" paths so visitors are 

not asked to decode the universe before converting.

- **Automation QA:** verify chat scripts, form submissions, newsletter automations, abandoned cart, 

TikTok event firing, and CRM tagging from admin/testing tools.

title: Head of Contact Center Operations - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Head of Contact Center Operations is the senior execution leader of MedPro and MP1's contact center — the person who makes the operation run, improves it continuously, and manages the managers who manage the floor. You report to the VP of Operations and translate their strategic direction into daily operational reality.



This role sits at the intersection of operator and thought partner. You have done this before: run high-volume, multi-channel service environments, built capacity plans between labor and systems, designed operating models from the ground up, and led teams through system migrations without losing service continuity. You are not here to hold the org steady — you are here to elevate it.



Where the VP of Operations sets the vision, you own delivery. When the VP of Operations needs to present performance to the COO, the data, the narrative, and the operational confidence behind it come from you. When the organization needs its service processes redesigned, its CRM environment assessed, or its team structure rebuilt — that work belongs to you.



Key Responsibilities:

Multi-Layer Team Leadership & People Development

• Lead, coach, and develop Operations Managers and Team Leads — you manage the managers, and they manage the floor. Build leaders who build others.

• Establish clear performance expectations, coaching cadences, and accountability frameworks across all leadership levels — weekly 1:1s, call calibrations, structured performance reviews, and real-time feedback loops.

• Drive workforce planning and capacity modeling: design the right staffing structure between labor, channels, and volume patterns — not just fill headcount, but engineer capacity.

• Build succession plans and internal development pathways that reduce external hiring dependency and create a promotion pipeline from within.

• Own recruitment strategy for the operations team in partnership with HR — attract, hire, and retain the caliber of leader and frontline talent that the CSO model demands.

• Foster a performance culture aligned to MedPro's values: Do the Right Thing, Figure It Out, Win as a Team, and Accountability & Ownership.



Operating Model Design & Service Delivery

• Assess the current state of the contact center operation — people, process, structure, channels, and systems — and translate findings into a clear-eyed redesign plan with sequenced priorities.

• Design and implement the operating model: how the team is structured, how work flows through channels, how performance is governed, and how the organization scales as the client base grows.

• Own day-to-day operational performance across all service channels — inbound and outbound voice,
, chat, and SMS — with direct accountability for SLA attainment, handle time, first-contact resolution, and quality scores.

• Build and maintain the full SOP and playbook library: every process documented, auditable, and owned. If it is not written down, it does not exist.

• Own the quality assurance framework — define rubrics, conduct or oversee audits, deliver structured coaching feedback to leads, and use quality data to drive continuous improvement.

• Manage real-time workload distribution across channels — monitor queues, adjust staffing deployment as volume shifts, and act on performance signals without waiting to be asked.



System Assessment & Service Technology Migration

• Conduct a thorough assessment of the current CRM and service technology environment — understanding what exists, what is working, what is limiting, and what migration path forward best serves the operation.

• Lead the end-to-end service system migration: requirements gathering, vendor evaluation, workflow configuration, data mapping, agent training, parallel testing, and go-live — while maintaining service continuity throughout.

• Design and configure case management workflows, escalation paths, SLA tracking, and omni-channel routing logic in the new system, aligned to MedPro's service model and client base.

• Partner with the internal technology team to ensure all system integrations — IVR handoffs, client account data, ticketing — flow cleanly from day one.

• Build post-migration operating model documentation: how cases are created, routed, resolved, escalated, and reported — so no process lives in someone's head.

• Drive full agent and Team Lead adoption: training materials, live coaching sessions, compliance monitoring, and performance metrics in the new system until it is the single active system of record.

• Design, build, and maintain IVR call flows that intelligently route clients, reduce handle time, and improve containment — build these, not just manage ones that already exist.



Performance Management, Data & Reporting

• Own the KPI framework — define the right metrics, build the dashboards, and drive accountability systems that make performance visible and improvable at every level of the team.

• Deliver structured weekly and monthly performance reports to the VP of Operations — covering channel SLA attainment, CSAT trends, quality scores, case volume, and system migration status.

• Translate floor-level data into operational decisions and clear narrative: what is driving variance, what specific action will improve it, and what the risk is if it is not addressed.

• Communicate proactively to the VP of Operations about service risks, capacity issues, and migration blockers — full transparency, solution-first framing, no surprises that should have been visible earlier.

• Identify and scope AI-assist and automation opportunities (IVR containment, agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection) — bring the VP of Operations a prioritized business case, not just ideas.



Client Experience & Regulatory Compliance

• Own the client experience at the operational level — serving as the escalation point for complex service issues and ensuring every client interaction reflects MedPro and MP1's positioning as a true compliance partner.

• Map and continuously improve the client journey across all contact touchpoints — identifying friction, closing gaps, and driving measurable improvements in client satisfaction scores.

• Ensure operational adherence to all applicable data security, privacy, and healthcare regulatory requirements including HIPAA and related standards.

• Partner with Sales and Client Success to align operational delivery with client growth, renewal, and expansion strategies.



Qualifications:

Required

• 10–15 years of total experience in contact center operations, service delivery, or BPO leadership — with significant, demonstrable accountability for team performance, service transformation, and operational change.

• Minimum 5 years in a senior people-management role with direct accountability for multi-layer teams (managers managing managers), department-level KPIs, and operational planning. Candidates who have only managed frontline teams — and not managed managers — will not be a fit.

• Proven experience operating in high-volume, multi-channel service environments with large numbers of customer interactions across voice,
, chat, and digital touchpoints. This is an execution role — we need someone who has run the floor at volume, not just designed programs from above it.

• Demonstrated experience leading a service system migration in a live contact center — transitioning a team from a legacy CRM to a modern platform while maintaining service continuity. Salesforce Service Cloud experience is strongly preferred.

• Hands-on capacity planning expertise: ability to model the right labor structure against channel mix, volume forecasts, and SLA requirements — and build the operating model that delivers it.

• Deep IVR design and multi-channel routing experience — you have built IVR flows from scratch, configured routing logic, and measured containment impact.

• Strong analytical capability — builds and interprets dashboards, identifies performance drivers, and communicates findings clearly to senior leadership.

• Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for daily interaction with U.S.-based leadership.

• Background in healthcare BPO, compliance services, regulated service industries, or U.S.-facing contact center operations strongly preferred.



Nice-to-Have

• Salesforce Service Cloud proficiency — case management, workflow rules, SLA configuration, omni-channel routing, and reporting.

• Experience with AI-assist tools in contact center settings: agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection, predictive routing.

• Workforce management platform experience (NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar).

• HIPAA familiarity and/or exposure to U.S. healthcare regulatory compliance operations.

• Track record of building or rebuilding operations within a high-growth or category-defining company.

• Six Sigma, COPC, or equivalent contact center quality certification.



Compensation & Benefits:

• Salary Range: $18-$24/hr 

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift).

• Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays

• Paid Leaves after 6 months of employment!



Basic Technical Requirements:

• A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

• With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

• Noise-canceling headset/headphones

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home

title: Web Designer — WordPress / Divi (Remote)
description:
Location: Remote, Philippines

Schedule: 20 hours/week — Tuesday–Saturday, 7:00 AM–11:00 AM PHT

Compensation: USD $450–700/month, based on experience and fit. Paid as a contractor — this role does not include benefits, PTO, or 13th month.

Engagement: 90-day paid trial, then ongoing contract



ABOUT TECHNOLOGY ALOHA



Technology Aloha is a web design agency in business for 13+ years. In the past year, we've won a Webby People's Voice Award, two Web Excellence Awards, and two C2A Honorable Mentions. We maintain a perfect 5/5 rating on Indeed. We're a small, fully remote team that builds custom WordPress sites for clients across the US.



We're selective about who we work with — both clients and tea
mbers. We do good work for good people: companies and nonprofits that are making a positive impact. We provide clear systems, direct communication, and the support you need to work independently and grow your skills. Kindness matters here.



We are a two-person team. This role would make three. We are small by choice, which means there is no traditional promotion ladder — but there is meaningful growth in skill, scope, and pay for the right person. We are looking for a contractor who wants steady, well-defined work for the long term, not a stepping stone to something else.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your work will be roughly:



- 70% — MAINTENANCE AND SMALL CLIENT REQUESTS. Text and image updates, navigation changes, form modifications, plugin troubleshooting, light layout fixes. Volume is steady. Tickets are tracked in HelpScout.

- 20% — DIVI 4 TO DIVI 5 CONVERSIONS. Run conversions on existing client sites, diagnose what breaks, scope the remediation, fix what fits in the agreed budget, and document the rest.

- 10% — NEW SITE BUILDS. Building approved Divi designs into pixel-perfect, fully responsive WordPress sites with maintainable structure.



You will own your tickets end-to-end. You will communicate proactively, flag scope, and ask before you assume.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



REQUIRED



- Working fluency in WordPress and Divi 4 (Theme Builder, layout customization, dynamic content)

- Working CSS — you can write clean custom CSS without leaning on a builder for everything

- Working PHP — you can read it, modify simple functions, and debug

- Strong troubleshooting instincts — you know how to isolate variables before guessing

- Excellent written English — clear, precise, professional

- Comfort with documented processes and the discipline to follow them

- Willingness to learn Divi 5 fluently within your first 45 days (we provide training)

- Reliable internet, working environment, and consistent availability during the schedule above



NICE TO HAVE



- Gravity Forms experience

- WooCommerce experience

- Fundraise Up or other donation platform experience

- Figma or Canva familiarity

- Mockup/design experience (we will not require it, but it shifts what we can hand you)



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



- DAY 14: You are productive on simple tickets without supervision.

- DAY 45: You are fluent in Divi 5 and handling conversion tickets independently.

- DAY 90: You are mostly autonomous on the maintenance queue and conversion work, flagging scope and asking the right questions without being prompted.



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application with three short written responses

2. Portfolio review

3. Virtual interview

4. Paid test project — a Divi 4 to Divi 5 conversion (USD $80, capped at 6 hours)

5. 90-day paid trial with a 30-day checkpoint



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF



- You have 10+ years of experience and prefer to work the way you have always worked

- You are not willing to follow a documented process unless you can show us yours is better

- You apply to dozens of jobs at once with the same generic message

- You list "expert in everything" — WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace, mobile apps, SEO, and graphic design — on your resume

- You cannot commit to the schedule or the part-time hours

- You expect to be told exactly what to do on every task



HOW TO APPLY



SUBJECT LINE: Designer, [Your Name] — [YYMMDD] (the date is your application date)



REQUIRED APPLICATION MATERIALS:



1. RESUME + PORTFOLIO. Include any WordPress sites you've built. Student projects are acceptable.

2. 1-MINUTE VIDEO. Tell us about a favorite Filipino food we should try — what it is, where to get it, and why you love it. Film in the space you'd actually be working from. We use the video to evaluate spoken English, your camera/mic, and your remote work environment — plus we genuinely want to get to know you.

3. WRITTEN RESPONSES. Answer the 5 screening questions in the application form: 



**Applications without all three components will not be reviewed.**



Apply for this with 7 application points on OnlineJobs.ph.



We read every application. We will respond to candidates who move forward within seven days.

title: Enterprise SaaS Software QA - (Remote, US Hours)
description:
Who We’re Looking For



We are seeking a highly experienced Senior QA Engineer who has worked directly with multi-vendor, multi-tenant SaaS platforms and enterprise clients. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the reliability and scalability of a sophisticated B2B eCommerce solution by developing and executing thoughtful, risk-based testing strategies.

This role requires experience testing software built with headless, open-source technologies and an understanding of composable architectures, API-driven systems, and client-specific feature deployments.

We’re also looking for someone who is highly proactive about identifying issues, uncovering gaps in processes, and helping improve QA practices before problems impact customers. Just as important, the right candidate must be a strong communicator and proactive collaborator, able to work closely with developers, product managers, and project managers to surface issues early and drive resolution. 

The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment and be comfortable working independently.

Availability during US business hours is required. Preferably could work night shift ( 8:00 PM - 5:00 AM Philippine Time)



Key Responsibilities

Testing & Execution

Plan and execute end-to-end testing for a complex, multi-tenant, multi-vendor SaaS platform.





Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing across storefronts, seller tools, and marketplace operations.





Write, maintain, and expand automated test scripts using Cypress or similar tools.





Create and manage API test suites using Postman or similar, validating request/response behavior across environments and tenant-specific implementations.





Test web applications built on open-source, headless commerce frameworks where front- and back-end services are decoupled.





Quality Assurance & Defect Management

Log and track bugs using Azure DevOps (or similar tools), working closely with developers on resolution and re-testing.





Identify root causes of defects and proactively stabilize automation suites to minimize false positives.





Contribute to post-release testing retrospectives to improve QA effectiveness and overall product quality.





Test Planning & Strategy

Define test plans tailored to the realities of multi-tenant environments, ensuring comprehensive coverage across configurations and client variations.





Collaborate with product managers and developers to translate complex requirements into structured, actionable test cases.





Anticipate quality risks specific to enterprise client usage, such as varying permissions, catalog structures, or feature toggles.





Reporting & Collaboration

Deliver timely QA reports, test coverage metrics, and risk assessments ahead of releases.





Work cross-functionally with distributed teams to ensure QA remains an integrated, forward-looking part of the development lifecycle.





Serve as the go-to QA resource for your assigned areas of the platform.





Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience

5+ years of experience in quality assurance or software testing roles.





Proven background testing multi-vendor SaaS platforms supporting enterprise clients.





Demonstrated ability to test in multi-tenant, cloud-based environments with varying configurations per tenant.





Hands-on experience with open-source, headless commerce or CMS frameworks.





Technical Skills

Proficiency with API testing tools such as Postman or similar.





Experience creating and maintaining automated test suites with Cypress or Sonarqube equivalent.





Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, Agile workflows, and CI/CD practices.





Soft Skills

Independent and highly organized; able to own QA across multiple modules or services.





Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.





Excellent written and verbal communication, especially in remote environments.

Cross?functional collaboration works effectively with product, engineering, and support to align expectations and prevent recurring issues.

Understands how modules, services, and data flows interact, enabling better root?cause analysis and prevention.

Adaptability in fast?moving environments able to adjust testing strategy quickly when requirements, priorities, or architectures shift.



Important - include your favorite sports team in your application so I know you read this.



Takes initiative in cross?team coordination, ensuring blockers, risks, and quality concerns are surfaced early and resolved collaboratively. Also, supports and mentors teammates, especially around QA best practices, test strategy, and stability?first thinking



=====

IMPORTANT:



Please include a PDF resume with your application.

Don't respond to me with AI please..we use AI for development and testing..but write me as a human..no AI slop :)

Community Management
