• Act as primary community contact; respond within one business day,

• Deliver monthly management reports and conduct regular site inspections,

• Issue violation notices and process architectural requests for Board review,

• Develop and maintain an annual maintenance plan,

• Manage projects: solicit bids, review contracts, schedule work, and report progress,

• Coordinate reserve studies and insurance coverage, including claims support, and

• Prepare for and attend Board and Annual meetings.



Financial Management

• Prepare and implement the annual budget with Board and membership approval,

• Review monthly financial reports and approve invoices,

• Oversee collections and delinquency enforcement with attorneys, and

• Advise the Board on fund management and investments.



Administrative Management

• Review and report on resale certifications and lender requests, and 

• Keep community web portals updated with relevant information.



Required Skills and Abilities

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills,

• Excellent customer service skills, 

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail,

• Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to work independently and seek out resources and information,

• Familiarity with the structure of community associations, governing documents, and applicable law, and 

• Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite.



Hardware & Internet Requirements:

• PC required

• 16GB RAM or higher

• Intel® Core i3, AMD Ryzen 3 or higher processor 

• 256GB Solid State Drive (SSD) storage or larger

• Microsoft® Windows 11 Home Operating System

• Reliable 10 Mbps+ internet with backup connection and power

• Noise-canceling headset and high-quality webcam



Education and Experience

• Minimum of 2 years’ experience as a Community Association Manager.

• Completion of the Community Association Institute M100 course.

• 4-year degree desired. 



Physical Requirements

• Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer



Contractors:

• Are not eligible for employee benefits such as paid time off (PTO), health insurance, or retirement plans, 

• Bill and are compensated only for hours worked, with no eligibility for overtime pay. The hourly rate remains consistent regardless of the number of hours worked, and

• Do not receive pay during company closures (e.g., holidays) unless they perform pre-approved work during those periods. We observe 14 holidays annually.



To reflect these differences, we are offering a higher hourly rate than that of a regular employee. This is intended to help offset costs such as health insurance and retirement and provide flexibility for unpaid time off.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for Hair Etc., a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, run a proven script, and book them onto the salon's calendar.



If you're a sales-oriented setter who loves high-volume work, runs scripts the way they were written, and is motivated by performance pay tied to real results — keep reading. If you want a low-pressure customer service job or you like "making the script your own," this won't be a fit.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on Hair Etc., a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market. You can see the salon directly:



- Google Maps Listing: share.google/iX1SgvUhBw386WHHg

- Instagram: 
/hairetcfontana/



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at Hair Etc. handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script word-for-word for the entire call, from greeting to booking. The only time you go off-script is to answer a client's specific question (directions, timing) or collect unique info.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We say "word-for-word" because that's how the role works — but we want to clear up the most common concern people have about that:



"Won't I sound like a robot if I'm reading a script?"



No. Think about the best actors in your favorite movies. They're saying lines someone else wrote. They don't sound robotic because they've rehearsed enough that the words feel natural, and they bring real warmth, tone, and presence to the delivery. THAT'S EXACTLY WHAT WE'RE AFTER. The script is the structure. Your tone, pacing, and warmth are what make it feel human.



We train for this. You'll rehearse, get coached on tonality and pacing, and review your own call recordings until the words feel like yours — even though they're not. The setters who do this best sound like they're having a natural conversation that just happens to follow a proven path.



The script DOES change over time — but only based on data. If something isn't landing in calls, we test a new version, measure the results, and update the script if it works better. What we don't do is let setters freelance individual changes on the fly, because then we can't tell what's working and what's not.



If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll genuinely consider it. We'll A/B test it together. If the data shows it works better, it becomes the newscript. That's the structured way changes happen here.



If that framing works for you, you'll thrive. If "follow a script and let us measure what works" feels suffocating, this role won't be a fit.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



- Advanced English with minimal accent. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- Strong spoken communication — clear voice, confident on calls, doesn't ramble, not soft-spoken.

- Script discipline. You're comfortable running proven scripts word-for-word in mandatory parts of the call. (See the script section above for context on what this actually means day-to-day.)

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Process-oriented. You follow standardized workflows. If you want to change something, you bring a clear, data-backed suggestion to your manager and wait for a decision.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between July 13 – July 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | tally.so/r/rjGXZN?job_platform=OnlineJobs.ph |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---

title: Senior Automotive Retoucher
description:
Louk Studio is a high-end automotive photography and video studio based in the Netherlands. We work across the full automotive spectrum — from hyper-luxury brands like Ferrari, Lamborghini, and Porsche to major mainstream brands including Fiat, Dacia, Opel, and Kia. Most of our mainstream work comes through the big agencies that outsource campaign production to us, and these projects often carry the biggest budgets and the most ambitious creative.



We're looking for an experienced Photoshop retoucher to handle our automotive post-production on an ongoing freelance basis. Consistent work, serious clients, high standards.



What you'll do:

Retouch automotive imagery for commercial campaigns and brand content. A typical assignment: we deliver a JPG of the car plus a background plate, and you deliver a clean, cut-out product image of the car placed on the background — fully retouched, paint clean, looking real and ready for client delivery.



Volume:

Assignments are around 10–20 hours each. The stronger your work, the more we send your way. Top performers can expect multiple assignments per month on an ongoing basis.



Who we're looking for:

Someone with a real portfolio in automotive retouch specifically. Not general product retouch, not portrait work — automotive. You should be comfortable working independently from a brief, hitting deadlines, and delivering at a level that holds up next to top global agency work.



Check our instagram page here to check our work (website currently being redesigned): . 
 



This is the standard your work needs to match.



Process:

Send your portfolio and a short note about your automotive retouch experience. If your work fits, we'll move to a paid test assignment — fully paid at your hourly rate, no unpaid work.



The test is real client work: a car cut-out placed cleanly on a white background, retouched to look real. No complex reflection work for the test — just clean retouch and a believable result. We'll evaluate both the quality of the final image and the time it takes you to deliver it.



From there, ongoing work for the right person.



Rate:

State your hourly rate when you apply.



Apply only if automotive retouch is genuinely your specialty. We don't have time to train.

title: Website Optimization Specialist for Cleaning Company Website
description:
Company Website:





Job Description:

We are looking for an experienced website optimization specialist to improve the website for our cleaning company, Cozy Almonds Cleaning.



We need someone who understands websites for cleaning companies, home service businesses, local service companies, or appointment-based businesses.



The goal is to make our website look more professional, mobile-friendly, trustworthy, and easier for customers to request a quote or book a cleaning.



Please review our current website before applying:





Important:

We do not want pricing listed on the website. Our quotes are given over the phone based on the details of the cleaning. The website should encourage customers to call, request a quote, or start the booking process.



Main Responsibilities:



Improve the homepage layout and customer flow.



Make it easy for customers to request a quote or book as soon as they land on the page.



Add strong call-to-action buttons such as Request a Quote, Book a Cleaning, or Call for a Quote.



Make the website mobile-first and easy to use from a phone.



Upload and place real photos of our cleaners cleaning.



Potentially add short videos of our cleaners cleaning.



Improve the cleaning checklist section so it looks more professional and organized.



Add or improve customer review sections.



Use trust-building elements like real team photos, reviews, service details, checklists, and before/after photos if available.



Make the website cleaner, easier to understand, and more conversion-focused.



Ideal Candidate:



Experience with cleaning company websites, home service websites, or local service business websites.



Understands conversion-focused design.



Understands mobile-first website design.



Can improve layout, images, reviews, booking buttons, and quote request flow.



Can give smart suggestions instead of only waiting for instructions.



Pays attention to detail and avoids generic work.



How to Apply:

Start your application with:



“I can optimize a cleaning website for bookings.”



Then answer these questions:



1. After reviewing 
, what are 3 specific improvements you would make?

2. Have you worked on cleaning company, home service, or local service websites before? Please send examples.

3. Since we do not show pricing online, how would you encourage customers to request a quote?

4. What would you improve on the mobile version of the website?

5. Send 2 websites you personally built or optimized and explain what you changed.

6. What access would you need to complete the work?

7. How would you protect the website while making changes?

8. How long would it take to complete the first homepage draft/update?



Paid Test Task:

Before hiring for the full project, we may ask for a small paid test task. This may include a homepage improvement plan or mockup showing:



Headline placement

Button placement

Review placement

Photo/video placement

Mobile layout suggestions



Compensation:

Fixed project pay: $200 USD



Possible bonus: $50 USD if the work is completed professionally, on time, mobile-friendly, and with minimal revisions.





Please do not apply if:



You only know basic website design but do not understand conversions.



You cannot explain how to improve a home service website.



You only give generic suggestions.



You think public pricing must be listed on the website.



You cannot show examples of previous website work.



Project Goal:

We want our website to look clean, professional, and trustworthy while making it easy for customers to request a quote or book a cleaning.

title: Creative Strategist & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
About the Role

You'll take existing video footage (mostly UGC from creators, plus AI-generated assets we produce in-house with tools like Higgsfield) and turn it into high-performing short-form video ads for TikTok and Meta. You'll also produce static ad creatives for the same campaigns.

This isn't a button-pushing editor role. You'll own the creative process end-to-end: ideating hooks and angles, scripting the ad narrative, and editing the final cut. To accelerate the strategic side, you'll have access to an internal Claude-based AI tool that generates hooks, scripting ideas, and competitor gap analysis on demand — so you'll never be staring at a blank page.

We're open to someone who's strong on editing and weaker on strategy, as long as you're hungry to grow into the strategist role. The AI tools will do a lot of the strategic heavy lifting early on; over time we want you developing that muscle yourself.

What You'll Do



Edit short-form video ads (TikTok, Meta Reels, Stories) using existing UGC and AI-generated footage

Produce static ad creatives for Meta campaigns

Develop hooks, angles, and concepts using our internal Claude AI tool and your own creative instincts

Script and storyboard ad narratives — turning a hook into a 15-30 second story arc

Match each client's brand guidelines, templates, and visual style (we provide all of this)

Produce multiple variations per concept for testing

Collaborate with the Nexocore team via Slack

Eventually work alongside other tea
mbers as we scale (media buyers, strategists, designers)



Requirements (Must-Haves)



Portfolio of D2C ad work is required. Your application will not be considered without sample ads you've edited for ecommerce brands. Brand films, wedding videos, and YouTube long-form do not count.

Strong short-form editing skills (TikTok, Reels) — hook-first pacing, native captions, jump cuts, layered b-roll

Experience with static ad creative (any tool — Figma, Canva, Photoshop, whatever you prefer)

Comfortable using AI tools as part of your creative workflow — this is non-negotiable

Strong written and spoken English

Reliable internet and the equipment to edit video efficiently

Self-directed — you can work flexibly without daily check-ins



Nice-to-Haves



Experience with Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, or other AI video generation tools

Familiarity with TikTok and Meta ad performance metrics (CTR, hook rate, thumbstop rate)

Prior agency experience working across multiple D2C brands

A point of view on what makes ads convert, not just look good



How to Apply

Send the following:



Your portfolio — 3–5 examples of D2C short-form ads you've edited, plus 2–3 static ad creatives. Link to a Google Drive, 
, portfolio site, or similar.

A short note (3–5 sentences) telling us: which ad in your portfolio you're most proud of, and why it worked.

Your hourly rate in USD.

Your weekly availability.



Applications without a D2C ad portfolio will not be reviewed.

We're looking to hire quickly. Strong applicants will be invited to a paid test project before any longer-term commitment.



About Nexocore

Nexocore is a digital marketing agency working with ecommerce (D2C) brands. We build and run paid social campaigns across TikTok and Meta, and creative is the engine of everything we do. We're looking for a creative strategist and editor to join our team and own the creative production for client ads.

title: Accountant
description:
**PLEASE MAKE SURE TO ATTACH/LINK YOUR RESUME AND VIDEO INTRODUCTION BEFORE APPLYING OTHERWISE YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE IGNORED**



Accountant



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 AM EST, with a 1-hour break

Salary: $1,400 per month



Job Overview: 



We are seeking an Accountant with strong Accounts Payable and Travel & Expense experience, ready to apply their knowledge and expertise in a hands-on, high-impact role and make it their own. Reporting directly to the Controller & Head of Finance, this role offers broad exposure, real ownership of the AP and expense management process, and close collaboration with Accounting, Finance, and Operations leadership. The ideal candidate is willing to own the AP and T&E process from end to end, is comfortable partnering with non-finance teams and explaining the “why” behind processes, and is eager to take on visibility, responsibility, and the opportunity to help build scalable financial processes while supporting month-end activities, vendor payments, expense workflows, and process improvements. 



Key Responsibilities:



Accounts Payable & Expense Management

• Own the end-to-end AP process, including vendor onboarding, invoice coding, approvals, and payment execution

• Manage corporate card and employee expense workflows using Ramp

• Monitor AP inbox and ensure accurate and timely processing of high-volume invoices, including production vendors, talent, and freelancers

• Investigate and resolve discrepancies while maintaining strong documentation and controls



General Ledger & Close

• Participate in closing AP at month-end

• Assist with identifying month-end accruals

• Perform balance sheet reconciliations (AP, credit cards payable, etc.)

• Maintain accurate financial records in NetSuite and/or Xero

• Audit, Controls & Compliance

• Support external audits, audit requests, and walkthroughs, as needed.

• Partner with the Head of Fin & Acctg Mgr to strengthen internal controls as the company scales

Media & Production Cost Accounting

• Collaborate with production, editorial, and operations teams to ensure accurate AP coding and vendor information gathering, cost tracking, and reconciling trackers to the general ledger.

• Develop an understanding of media-specific accounting areas such as production costs, talent payments, and deal-related expenses

• Process Improvement & Systems & Lead Ramp / T&E Trainings

• Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve efficiency using systems, Excel, and policy documentation

• Contribute to system optimization across AP and expense management tools

• Lead onboarding and training sessions for managers and new employees related to Ramp, T&E reconciliation expectations, • receipt collection requirements, and expense submission best practices

• Educate non-finance teams on expense coding structure and departmental coding expectations to improve financial reporting accuracy, budget tracking, and spend visibility

• Partner cross-functionally to reinforce timely reconciliations, proper documentation standards, and consistent coding practices across the organization



Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with Accounts Payable and T&E

• Experience with or exposure to accounting systems such as NetSuite, Xero, Ramp, or similar

• Ability to work independently, manage competing deadlines, and take ownership in a lean environment

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting

• Experience working in media, technology, or high-growth companies

• Experience in a startup or fast-scaling organization

title: Full-Stack SaaS Web App Developer, AI Prototype to Production
description:
Company Overview



We are seeking a skilled Full-Stack SaaS Web App Developer who can help turn AI-built prototypes into production-ready web apps, SaaS-style tools, and internal team systems. This role requires substantial availability during U.S. Eastern business hours for communication, collaboration, updates, and technical questions.



Position Overview



We are hiring a Full-Stack SaaS Web App Developer to support the development of internal tools, team portals, dashboards, and SaaS-style web applications.



Some apps are currently built or prototyped in Lovable and connected to GitHub. This role requires someone who can review existing AI-generated app code, determine what can be reused or improved, connect the backend properly, set up deployment, and help move prototypes into stable production environments.



This is not a basic website role. We need someone who understands frontend, backend, databases, authentication, APIs, deployment, and app logic. Because this work involves ongoing collaboration and technical decision-making, the person must be available for regular communication during U.S. Eastern hours.



Key Responsibilities

• Review Lovable/AI-generated apps and connected GitHub repositories

• Turn prototypes into production-ready web apps

• Build and clean up React, Next.js, and/or TypeScript applications

• Set up or improve Supabase, PostgreSQL, Firebase, or similar backend/database systems

• Build dashboards, portals, admin panels, forms, and workflow tools

• Set up authentication, user roles, and permissions

• Connect approved APIs, webhooks, and third-party tools

• Collaborate with our automation specialist on n8n or API-based workflows when needed

• Deploy apps using Vercel, Railway, Render, VPS, or similar platforms

• Set up environment variables and secure API key handling

• Identify what is functional, what is prototype-only, and what should wait

• Document setup, architecture, deployment steps, and technical decisions

• Provide regular updates, blockers, and questions



Qualifications

• Proven experience with full-stack web app development

• Experience with React, Next.js, and/or TypeScript

• Experience with GitHub and version control

• Experience with Supabase, PostgreSQL, Firebase, or similar backend/database tools

• Experience setting up authentication, user roles, and permissions

• Familiarity with API integrations and webhooks

• Experience deploying apps with Vercel, Railway, Render, VPS, or similar platforms

• Ability to review existing code and explain what should be reused, refactored, or rebuilt

• Strong communication and documentation habits

• Substantial availability during U.S. Eastern business hours



Preferred Skills

• Experience with Lovable, Bolt, Replit, or other AI/no-code/low-code app builders

• Experience taking AI-generated prototypes into production

• Familiarity with n8n, Zapier, or Make

• Experience with Stripe, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Claude, or other AI APIs

• Experience with ClickUp, Google Drive, Gmail, Google Calendar, or similar business tools

• Experience building internal tools, agency operations systems, SaaS apps, dashboards, or portals

• Understanding of secure app development practices



Compensation

Pay is negotiable based on experience and technical depth.



Application Process

To apply for this position, candidates MUST complete all of the following steps:



1. Submit a resume outlining full-stack development, SaaS, web app, or internal tool experience.

2. Upload examples or screenshots of previous apps, dashboards, portals, SaaS products, GitHub repositories, or deployment projects.

3. Submit a newly recorded video introduction where you:

    State the current date

    Briefly explain your full-stack development experience

    Describe your experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, GitHub, Supabase, APIs, and deployment

title: Game Developer & Porting Engineer (Agentic AI · Godot)
description:
Remote · [Full-time / Contract-to-hire — TBD]



This is a brand-new role — the first dedicated hire for Bitrograde Labs. You won't slot into someone else's process; you'll help define how a small studio ships complete games fast by directing AI. Ground floor, real latitude, real ownership.



About Bitrograde Labs

Bitrograde Labs ships small, complete, fairly-priced games on a fast cadence — and helps outside creators finish and launch theirs. No DLC. No microtransactions. Complete games at honest prices. Remember when gaming was fun?



We build by directing AI agents, not by typing code line by line. Your job is to make that produce shippable games — not demos that fall apart in the wild.



How You'll Work (read this part twice)

You will not hand-write most of the code. You'll orchestrate AI agents (Claude Code and similar) to do it. But "doesn't type code" is not "doesn't read code." You are the judgment in the loop: you architect the approach, review what the agents produce, catch them when they're confidently wrong, and refuse to ship what you can't explain. This is the difference between agentic engineering — which works — and vibe coding — which passes a quick test and breaks later. We do the former.



The Role

You alternate between two modes, never both at once:



Build mode: direct AI agents to take a prototype to a finished, shippable game — ~80% in Godot (GDScript), the rest in web tech (JavaScript/TypeScript).

Port mode (after a game ships): get finished titles onto every platform that makes sense.

This is roughly a 50/50 split — you'll spend about as much time porting finished titles as building new ones. The team handles go-to-market, so you stay focused on the game and the build.



What You'll Do

In build mode:



Direct AI agents to build games in Godot (primary) and web/JS (occasional)

Architect the approach and write tight specs/constraints before the agents start

Read, review, and debug everything the agents produce — own it as if you'd typed it

Run adversarial cross-checks (e.g. a second model reviewing significant changes) and fix what they surface

Polish, harden, and ship

In port mode:



Godot titles: desktop (Windows/Mac/Linux) and mobile via Godot export; console (Switch 1 & 2 / PS5 / Xbox Series) via W4 Consoles middleware

Web titles: desktop via Electron/Tauri, mobile via Capacitor, plus Steam and Apple TV

Handle platform integration (controllers, achievements, saves), certification, and store submission

For a web title that earns a console release: scope and coordinate a native rebuild or an external porting partner (no push-button path exists for web ? console)



Must Have

You're a gamer. You play, you have taste, you know what "finished and fun" feels like.

Hands-on agentic AI development experience. You've actually shipped by orchestrating AI coding agents — not just chatted with a model.

You can read, review, and debug Godot / GDScript fluently. You don't have to love typing it, but you must catch a bad implementation, reason about architecture, and explain any line the AI wrote. If you can't read it, you don't ship it — and we treat "the AI wrote it and nobody understands it" as a fireable risk, not a feature.

At least one shipped game. Any size — you've crossed the finish line before.

Comfortable with build pipelines (GitHub Actions / CI-CD, multi-platform builds).



Nice to Have

Web game experience (JavaScript/TypeScript, Electron/Tauri/Capacitor) for the ~20% non-Godot titles

Prior console work (W4 Consoles; certification for Nintendo / Sony / Microsoft)

Mobile and Apple TV deployment

Familiarity with agent orchestration workflows and 
 build tooling



You'll Thrive Here If

You actually finish things

You think a complete game at a fair price is a moral stance, not just a business model

"Remember when gaming was fun" makes you nod



APPLY HERE:

description:
ABOUT US:

We are a fast growing e-commerce brand operating on Amazon, Shopify and other ecommerce platforms. We specialize in creating high-quality products and are scaling our catalog rapidly. We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, and data-driven Amazon Launch Manager to take our new products from the initial sourcing phase all the way to a successful Page 1 ranking. 



ROLE SUMMARY: 

As our New Product Launch Manager, you will own the entire launch lifecycle. You will research new product opportunities, optimize listings for maximum conversion, manage the launch budget, and execute ranking strategies (PPC, Vine, external traffic) to ensure a highly profitable launch.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

New Product Opportunity Research: Use Amazon product opportunity research tools such as Hilium10, Jungle Scout, Amazon Opportunity Explorer and similar tools to  identify profitable niches, analyze search volume, estimate sales, and evaluate competition to discover products with unmet customer demand and make data-driven product development decisions.

Listing Creation & Optimization: Write highly persuasive, SEO-optimized product titles, bullet points, and descriptions. Manage flat files, backend search terms, and coordinate A+ content creation.

Competitor & Keyword Research: Conduct deep keyword research using Helium 10 to map out target keywords for organic ranking and PPC campaigns.

Launch Strategy Execution: Execute 30-day launch roadmaps using Amazon Vine, pricing strategies, and initial PPC setup (Exact, Phrase, Broad, and Auto campaigns).

Supply Chain Coordination: Communicate with freight forwarders and suppliers to track shipments, ensure barcodes (FNSKU/UPC) are correct, and manage initial inventory intake.

Performance Tracking: Monitor daily unit session percentage (conversion rate), click-through rates, keyword ranking positions, and TACOS during the critical "honeymoon period."



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience specifically launching products on Amazon, Shopify, EBay, Walmart Market Place.

Expert-level mastery of Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Frankenstein) or Jungle Scout.

Strong understanding of Amazon's A9/A10 algorithm and compliance guidelines.

Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Amazon PPC management.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Reliable high-speed internet connection and a backup power source.



COMPENSATION &SCHEDULE:

Highly competitive compensation package including base pay, performance based incentives, insurance plan.

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Location: Remote (Philippines preferred).

Trial/Probation Period: 1-month paid probation period.

title: Creative Content Director
description:
About the Role



Refined Touch Media is looking for a Creative Content Director who can help transform ideas into engaging content that captures attention and drives conversations.



This is not a typical social media manager role.



We're not looking for someone who simply follows instructions or edits videos. We're looking for someone who can think strategically, research trends, develop creative concepts, and bring fresh ideas to the table.



The right person will help lead the creative direction of content across YouTube, Instagram,
, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other digital platforms.



Your goal is simple:



Take creative work off my plate while elevating the quality of the content we produce.



Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

Research content trends, formats, and emerging opportunities

Develop content concepts and campaign ideas

Identify hooks, angles, and storytelling opportunities

Study competitors and industry leaders for inspiration

Bring new ideas proactively instead of waiting for assignments

Content Production

Edit short-form and long-form video content

Create engaging graphics and visual assets

Design thumbnails and promotional materials

Repurpose content across multiple platforms

Improve pacing, retention, and viewer engagement

Content Planning

Build content calendars and publishing schedules

Recommend content based on audience interests and business goals

Organize content ideas and production workflows

Help prioritize high-impact opportunities

Copy & Messaging

Write captions, titles, descriptions, and calls-to-action

Create platform-specific messaging

Maintain consistency with brand voice and positioning

What Success Looks Like

Content consistently feels creative, intentional, and engaging

New ideas are regularly presented without being asked

Content quality improves over time

Videos have stronger retention and engagement

Creative decisions are backed by research, not guesswork

The owner spends less time managing content creation

Required Skills

Advanced video editing experience

Strong understanding of visual storytelling

Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Canva, or similar tools

Graphic design experience

Strong copywriting ability

Ability to analyze content performance and trends

Excellent communication and organization skills

Bonus Skills

Motion graphics

YouTube strategy

Thumbnail design

AI-assisted content workflows

Marketing and advertising knowledge

Experience working with service-based businesses

Who Excites Us



We love people who are naturally curious.



You constantly ask:



Why did this video perform well?

What would make this more engaging?

How can we improve this idea?

What trend should we be paying attention to?



You don't wait for permission to think creatively.



You enjoy researching, experimenting, and finding new ways to capture attention.



You take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks.



You care about producing work that makes people stop scrolling.



Most importantly, you understand that great content isn't just editing. It's strategy, psychology, storytelling, and execution working together.



Work Environment & Benefits

Remote position

Flexible schedule

Trust-based culture

Performance-based growth opportunities

Direct collaboration with leadership

Opportunity to help shape the creative direction of a growing marketing agency



We're not looking for someone to simply manage content.



We're looking for someone who can help create content worth paying attention to.

title: US Bookkeeping Advisor
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

------------------------------------------------ APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: 
 ---------------------------------------------

Why Housecall Pro?



Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes.



We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, employees, and Pros grow and succeed together. Leadership is as focused on growing tea
mbers’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.



Role Overview:



As a Team Lead, Bookkeeping / US Bookkeeping Advisor you balance team management with individual contribution. You have expertise in U.S. Bookkeeping, and use your knowledge to develop and grow others. You strive for excellence in managing ongoing bookkeeping tasks (including month-end reconciliation and close, and portfolio management), and the support and long-term success of our accounting customers. You are a great communicator who is comfortable taking on complex accounting projects with a diverse set of stakeholders. You bring an analytical mind to constantly improve the efficiency and efficacy of your projects. You use your experience to be a true consultant for small business accounting in the U.S. home services space.



Our Accounting Solutions team is focused on partnering with our service professionals to successfully onboard, deliver bookkeeping, and support their businesses into our accounting platform. As a Bookkeeping Specialist, you contribute to an entrepreneurial, enthusiastic and client-focused team dedicated to making accounting pain-free and to championing our Pros to success. As one offering within our broader fintech suite, Accounting Solutions tea
mbers will also gain exposure to a wide variety of other embedded financial products including payments, banking, card issuance, and more.



Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our Pros. Our success is their success.



What you do each day:



Ensure that the Bookkeeping team is providing world-class service for our Pros

Lead training and coaching sessions for tea
mbers

Delegate resource allocation, team attendance, and track key metrics for the team

Meet month-end service delivery deadlines for all dedicated accounts, including all actions necessary to deliver completed and reconciled books

Guide our customers through a white-glove onboarding journey and ensure that each customer is confident and has completed books once the onboarding journey is complete

Draw upon your extensive bookkeeping and accounting expertise to answer client questions, including financial statement errors, chart of accounts cleanup, sales tax matters, unresolved A/P and/or A/R issues, merchant services, and questions regarding third-party interactions

Foster exceptional customer experiences and interactions, and employ robust organizational and communication skills to guarantee timely client follow-ups

Qualifications:



3+ years of U.S. bookkeeping/accounting experience with in-depth understanding of SMB accounting methods and processes, including:

Consolidation and preparation of financial statements

Month-end book close and consolidation process, including journal entries, account reconciliations and flux analysis, A/P and A/R

Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance, a similar certification or level of experience (such as QBO Proadvisor)

1+ years experience leading or mentoring others

What will help you succeed in this role:



Finding joy in accuracy and efficiency

Strong expertise in troubleshooting any bookkeeping and tax-related questions

Track record of managing multiple projects with a strong attention to detail

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Excellent people skills: must be personable, patient, and good-humored

Self-starter mentality and independent thinker; intelligent and effective problem-solver

Interest or experience in home service business trades is a plus

Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.



Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.



We support more than 40,000 businesses and have over 1,800 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we’d love to hear from you.



Housecall Pro celebrates diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law.



Location Dependent Information



This role is open to candidates and the expected salary range for this role is $17,388 - $21,735 USD annually. The specific hourly rate for the successful candidate will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. Housecall Pro is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth.

Preferred Experience

Education and Experience

Work Arrangement

Physical Requirements

Hardware & Internet Requirements

Contractors

To reflect these differences, we are offering a higher hourly rate than that of a regular employee. This is intended to help offset costs such as health insurance and retirement and provide flexibility for unpaid time off.

title: Marketing Operations Coordinator
description:
Key Responsibilities 



1. The Silver Peaks Circle (Referral Program) :



*Day-to-day operational ownership of the firm’s referral program. This is the primary lead-generation channel for 2026. 



*Maintain 
 landing page — monitor submissions, troubleshoot form issues, update content quarterly. 



*Manage Circle member CRM records — tag every contact with segment (Inner Circle / Allied Professional / Friend of the Firm), update status when relationships change. 



*Trigger handwritten note workflow within 72 hours of any introduction received — draft note content for CEO signature, manage stationery inventory, track sent dates. 



*Coordinate Tier I gift fulfillment via Goody, Greetabl, or equivalent vendor when an introduction results in a booked consult. 



*Coordinate Tier II honorarium payments when a referred firm signs as a client — issue check, draft personal note, ensure feature in next Circle Letter. 



*Author and distribute the Quarterly Circle Letter — two pages, Circle members only, drafted in firm voice, reviewed by CEO before sending. 



*Track all Circle KPIs in a weekly dashboard — Active Members, Qualified Introductions, Consults Booked, Clients Signed, Lifetime Value of Referred Clients. 



*Coordinate logistics for the Annual Silver Peaks Legacy Dinner — venue, invitations, attendee management. 



2. The Podcast Program :

The podcast is the firm’s top-of-funnel lead engine. The Coordinator manages everything except the actual interview. 



Guest Pipeline :



*Maintain the guest pipeline across three buckets: Inner Circle clients (1/month), allied professionals (1/month), and prospective clients (2/month). 



*Research and source prospective client guests using LinkedIn Sales Navigator — build target lists of law firm owners matching ideal client profile. 



*Draft personalized guest outreach in CEO voice for review and sending — peer-recognition framing, never sales-pitch framing. 



*Build a pre-interview research dossier for each guest: firm background, practice area, recent LinkedIn activity, likely strategic gaps. Sent to CEO 48 hours before recording. 



Production & Repurposing :



*Coordinate all recording logistics — scheduling, calendar holds, recording platform setup, sending prep materials to guests. 



*Manage post-production handoff with audio editor or producer, including episode artwork, show notes, and metadata. 



*Repurpose every episode into the standard distribution package: 1 LinkedIn carousel, 2 quote graphics, 1 short-form video clip, 1 newsletter mention, and 1 blog adaptation. 



*Publish across all channels on the agreed cadence — typically Tuesday episode drop, Wednesday–Friday social distribution, Sunday newsletter mention. 



Conversion Tracking :



*Track every prospective-client guest from interview through post-episode follow-up to consult booking. Document outcomes in the CRM. 



*Report monthly on guest-to-consult conversion rates by guest type. This is the metric that proves the podcast lead-gen thesis.

 



3. Content & Campaign Execution :



*The standing content rhythm continues alongside the two new programs. The Coordinator owns its execution. 



*Execute the weekly
 rhythm — one podcast-tied
 and one authority
 per week per the active quarterly marketing plan. 



*Coordinate the direct-mail authority sequence — book shipments to every new lead, biweekly postcard cadence, mailing list hygiene. 



*Manage monthly credibility asset releases — frameworks, scorecards, case studies. Coordinate design, write supporting copy, schedule distribution. 



*Support quarterly authority webinars — promotion campaigns, registration tracking, replay distribution. 



*Maintain the firm’s social media presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and Spotify — with content priority weighted toward LinkedIn as the highest-value channel for law firm owners. 



*Write and design basic marketing materials in Canva or equivalent — social graphics,
 headers, simple PDFs, lead-magnet templates. Always within brand guidelines. 



4. Lead Attribution, Reporting & CRM :



*The Coordinator is the steward of marketing data. Every lead, every introduction, every guest interaction has a record. 



*Configure and maintain CRM fields for lead source attribution — Referred By, Referral Date, Referral Path (form / personal / event / podcast), Reward Tier Earned. 



*Ensure every inbound consult is tagged with its true source. No “unknown” sources after 30 days. 



*Maintain the weekly lead-flow pipeline dashboard — leads added, qualified, contacted, booked, signed, by source. 



*Prepare a monthly marketing performance report for the CEO and fractional CMO covering: Circle KPIs, podcast guest-to-consult conversion,
 engagement, content performance, and lead source mix. 



*Identify weekly trends and surface them to leadership — “we got three referrals from the same allied professional this month” is the kind of pattern this role catches. 



5. Strategic Planning Participation :



*Participate in quarterly marketing planning sessions with the CEO and fractional CMO. 



*Draft and present recommendations for the annual marketing plan and budget. 



*Bring data-grounded ideas — the Coordinator is the person who sees what is working and what is not at the operational level. That perspective is expected at the planning table.





Skills & Requirements 



Soft Skills 



Writes in the firm’s voice naturally — composed, precise, empathetically direct. Knows when to push back if asked to draft something that sounds urgent or hype-driven. 



Detail-oriented to a fault. The CRM record, the spelling of a guest’s firm name, the postage on a handwritten note — all of it matters. 



Proactive and self-directed. Operates in multiple time zones with minimal supervision. 



Comfortable interfacing directly with law firm owners and allied professionals when scheduling, sending follow-ups, or coordinating gift fulfillment. Represents the brand without being told to. 



Strong written communication in English. 



Technical Requirements 



3–5 years of marketing coordination or executive marketing assistant experience, ideally in a professional-services firm (law, accounting, consulting, financial advisory). 



Hands-on CRM experience — HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, or equivalent. Comfortable building custom fields, workflows, and reports. 



LinkedIn Sales Navigator proficiency — lead sourcing, list building, search filtering. 



Canva or Adobe Express for design execution. Working knowledge of basic visual design principles. 



Podcast production workflow familiarity — Riverside, Descript, or similar platforms. Does not need to be an audio editor. 



 marketing platform experience (Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, ConvertKit, or comparable). 



Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 fluency. 



Comfortable with project management tools — Asana, ClickUp, Trello, or equivalent. 



Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field preferred but not required if equivalent experience demonstrated. 



Bonus Qualifications 



Prior experience working with or marketing to law firm owners. 



Familiarity with Clio, Smokeball, or other legal practice management software (for understanding the audience, not for operating). 



Experience with referral or ambassador programs in any prior role. 



Direct mail program execution experience. 



Light copywriting and editing skills — the role drafts the Circle Letter, social posts, and
 content for CEO review. 



First 90 Days Expectations 



New hires in this role have a clear ramp. This is the structure for the first quarter. 



Month One — Learn & Configure 



Complete onboarding on Silver Peaks brand voice, services, and ideal client profile. 



Audit current CRM data and rebuild attribution fields per the Circle program specification. 



Review the existing podcast back-catalog and document the current production workflow. 



Begin shadowing the CEO on guest research and Circle member touchpoints. 



Month Two — Take Ownership 



Take primary ownership of the Circle handwritten note workflow, gift fulfillment, and quarterly Circle Letter. 



Own the podcast guest pipeline for prospective-client outreach (CEO continues to handle Inner Circle and allied professional invitations). 



Take ownership of the weekly content rhythm —
s, social, blog adaptations. 



Deliver the first monthly performance report to leadership. 



Month Three — Optimize 



Bring forward at least two data-grounded recommendations for what is working and what should change. 



Identify any operational bottlenecks slowing the Circle or podcast programs and propose fixes. 



Demonstrate ability to run a full week of program execution without active CEO oversight. 



Participate in the Q4 marketing planning session as a contributing voice. 



 



What Makes This Role Different 



This is not a generic marketing operations coordinator role. The person in this seat is the operational backbone for two programs that together represent the firm’s primary growth strategy for 2026. The work is structured, measurable, and high-trust. 



The right person treats every detail — the spelling of a guest’s firm name, the timing of a handwritten note, the framing of a LinkedIn post — as a small contribution to the elite standard the brand has set. They do not need to be reminded that those details matter. 



In return, this role offers direct access to a CEO and fractional CMO who treat marketing as a craft, a clear scoreboard, and the opportunity to build the operational systems behind a firm targeting $5M in annual revenue within five years.

title: Amazon OA Sourcing VA | 3P Mercury Experience a Plus
description:
Looking for an Amazon Online Arbitrage specialist focused on sourcing & database building. This is a singular-focus role: find great ASINs and build our Lead Vault. No POs, no operations, no logistics. Just sourcing.



We use 3P Mercury as our sourcing tool. If you have solid OA/Amazon sourcing experience, we'll train you on the tool. If you already know 3P Mercury, even better.



About Us

We run a growing Amazon Online Arbitrage business. This role handles sourcing and Lead Vault building exclusively. Your job is to find and add quality ASINs to the database. That's it.



What You'd Be Doing

Finding ASINs using manual sourcing techniques, reverse sourcing tools, and market research

Evaluating ASINs by checking sales velocity, profitability potential, competitive dynamics, and sourcing feasibility

Building & maintaining our Lead Vault by importing qualified ASINs into 3P Mercury with proper sourcing data

Validating sources by confirming product match, pack sizes, supplier legitimacy, and ongoing availability

Reporting on weekly/monthly database growth and sharing insights on trends

What We're Looking For

Must-Have:



? Hands-on experience with Amazon OA: you know sourcing, profitability math, and FBA dynamics

? Proven sourcing track record: you've found and sourced ASINs (any method is fine)

? Keepa proficiency: you can read charts, use Product Finder, and pull seller data

? Attention to detail: validating sources, confirming product match, pack sizes, supplier legitimacy. If you've read this far, make sure your application header starts with 3PM so we know you're paying attention.

? Fast, reliable internet and a quiet workspace

? Coachability: willing to learn our sourcing system and philosophy

Nice-to-Have:



? Experience with 3P Mercury (we have a complete training guide if you're new)

? Experience with ArbiSource (you'll have access and will be expected to use it)

? Familiarity with other reverse sourcing tools (Nepeto, Tactical Arbitrage)

? Experience with cashback stacking (BeFrugal, Rakuten, TopCashback)

? Knowledge of discounted gift card sourcing

Screening Questions

Please answer these in your application. We're assessing both your OA sourcing experience and your understanding of our approach.



1) Walk us through your sourcing process. What tools do you use? How many ASINs can you typically find and validate in a week? What criteria do you evaluate before d
 to source an ASIN?



2) Explain what you look for when evaluating an ASIN for profitability. What metrics matter most to you? Why?



3) What is the key difference between traditional OA sourcing and the 3P Mercury sourcing method? If you've used 3PM, explain how the approach works differently and why that matters. If you've never used 3PM, just write: never used 3PM.



4) What's your biggest challenge with sourcing? Where do you get stuck or lose time?



5) Why are you interested in this role? What appeals to you about focusing exclusively on sourcing and database building?



Note: We're looking for practical sourcing knowledge and someone who can explain their process clearly. Generic answers won't work.



Position Details

Type: Part-Time (flexible hours)

Schedule: Approximately 15-20 hours/week (negotiable based on performance)

Rate: Competitive, based on experience. Please include your desired hourly rate.

Location: Remote (Philippines-based preferred per OnlineJobs.ph)

Start: Flexible. We want to find the right person, not rush the hire.

Tools Provided: 3P Mercury access, Keepa subscription, any required sourcing tool subscriptions

How to Apply

Answer the 5 screening questions above, be specific and detailed

Share your relevant Amazon OA experience (years, types of businesses supported, tools used)

Describe your experience with 3P Mercury specifically: how long you've used it, what features you use most, and the size of the largest Lead Vault you've worked with

Include your desired hourly rate and available hours per week

We take applications seriously and ask that you do too. Please use 4 or more apply points when submitting. This helps us know you're genuinely interested in this specific role and not mass applying.

We're looking for someone with solid OA sourcing fundamentals. If you have 3P Mercury experience, great, you'll jump right in. If you don't but you're a solid sourcer, we'll train you on our system. We value coachability and attention to detail.

Experience with packaging development.

Experience with product commercialization and product launches.

Experience conducting overseas factory audits.

Fluency in Mandarin, Vietnamese, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese, or other relevant languages is a plus.

Critical Success Factors



The successful candidate will demonstrate:



Exceptional integrity and ethical conduct.

Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Data-driven decision-making.

Aggressive but professional negotiation skills.

Ability to challenge suppliers constructively.

Ability to identify cost-saving opportunities.

Strong attention to detail.

Ownership mentality and accountability.

Ability to operate independently with minimal supervision.

Fiduciary Duty, Ethics & Conflict of Interest Requirements



This position is held to the highest fiduciary and ethical standards.



The employee must always act solely in the best interests of the Company and its affiliated entities.



As a condition of employment:



The employee may not accept commissions, kickbacks, rebates, gifts, referral fees, overrides, consulting fees, or any other compensation from suppliers, manufacturers, brokers, trading companies, freight forwarders, consultants, or other third parties doing business with the Company.

The employee may not own, directly or indirectly, any financial interest in a supplier, manufacturer, broker, trading company, or service provider utilized by the Company without prior written disclosure and approval.

The employee may not participate in any purchasing, sourcing, supplier selection, or contract negotiation decision that presents an actual or perceived conflict of interest.

The employee must immediately disclose any actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest.

The employee must comply with all Company procurement, ethics, anti-bribery, anti-corruption, confidentiality, and supplier conduct policies.

All supplier recommendations must be based solely on quality, compliance, service, reliability, risk profile, and total cost of ownership considerations.

Any violation of these requirements may result in immediate termination and may subject the employee to legal action where applicable.

Confidentiality & Intellectual Property

As a condition of employment, the employee must:

Return all Company records and materials upon termination of employment.

Assign to the Company all work product, supplier relationships developed on behalf of the Company, sourcing strategies, databases, specifications, packaging designs, processes, and intellectual property created during employment.

Refrain from using Company information for personal gain or for the benefit of any third party.

Performance Metrics (KPIs)



Success in this role will be measured through:



Annual cost savings achieved

Supplier quality performance

On-time delivery performance

Supplier responsiveness

Regulatory compliance performance

Successful product launches

Supply continuity and risk reduction

Packaging project completion

Inventory availability support

Negotiated improvements in pricing and payment terms

Supplier diversification and contingency planning effectiveness



This position serves as a trusted steward of the Company's global supply chain and is expected to consistently act in the Company's best interests while maximizing value, minimizing risk, and maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and integrity.

title: Accounts Executive
description:
Job Timing: 9:00am to 6:00pm MST US Time Zone

Location: Remote

Salary:15k - 20k php/month

Job Type: Full-Time

Department: Finance / Operations / Sales Support



Job Overview:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Account Executive to manage financial records, support sales operations, and maintain strong client relationships. The ideal candidate will be responsible for bookkeeping, back-office coordination, invoicing, client onboarding, and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.



Key Responsibilities:

Bookkeeping & Financial Management



Maintain accurate financial records and ledgers.

Record daily transactions, reconcile bank statements, and manage accounts receivable/payable.

Assist in preparing financial summaries, reports, and budgets.

Ensure timely and accurate invoice generation and payment follow-ups.

Back Office & Administrative Support



Handle documentation, data entry, and internal record-keeping.

Coordinate with different departments (sales, operations, HR) to ensure smooth internal processes.

Maintain organized filing systems and client databases.

Invoicing & Billing



Prepare and issue invoices to clients in a timely manner.

Track payments, manage outstanding invoices, and send payment reminders.

Coordinate with the finance team to reconcile billing and payment discrepancies.

Client Onboarding & Relationship Management



Assist in onboarding new clients by gathering required information and ensuring a smooth setup process.

Maintain strong client communication to ensure satisfaction and resolve issues promptly.

Support account management by tracking contract renewals and client feedback.

Sales Communication & Retention



Collaborate with the sales team to prepare proposals, quotes, and follow-up communications.

Support client retention initiatives by building long-term relationships and ensuring consistent service quality.

Identify upselling or cross-selling opportunities in coordination with the sales team.

Reporting & Coordination



Prepare periodic reports on sales activities, invoicing, and client accounts.

Provide administrative and operational support to management.

Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures in all account-related activities.



Qualifications & Skills:



Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

2+ years of experience in bookkeeping, account management, or back-office operations.

Proficiency in MS Office and accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, or ERP systems).

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail.

Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.

Customer service mindset and problem-solving attitude.



Preferred Skills (Optional):



Experience in client onboarding and CRM systems.

Knowledge of sales support and retention strategies.

Familiarity with financial reporting tools and automation platforms.
